name: Milk and Cookies with Santa at Parker Fieldhouse
when_note: Sunday, December 13, 2026, two sessions: 12:45 to 1:45 PM and 2:15 to 3:15 PM
ages: Kids' Zone ages 3 to 6 with family
paras: Parker Recreation hosts Milk and Cookies with Santa at the Parker Fieldhouse, 18700 E Plaza Dr, on Sunday, December 13, 2026. Two one-hour sessions run, 12:45 to 1:45 PM and 2:15 to 3:15 PM, and it is part of the Kids' Zone holiday lineup for children ages 3 to 6.
Registration is $16 for Parker residents and $18 for non-residents, and space is limited. Kids enjoy milk, cookies and a visit with Santa, so register early through Parker Recreation.
tip: Pick the first session for preschoolers who nap in the afternoon.

name: Winter Wonderland with Santa at The Learning Experience
paras: The Learning Experience in Parker opens its doors to the public for a free Winter Wonderland with Santa on Wednesday, December 16, 2026, from 6 to 8 PM at 12215 Pardee St. Families can meet Santa and take photos, then settle in for a holiday storytime read-aloud.

Kids can decorate cookies with their family, make reindeer food, try festive crafts and visit a temporary tattoo station, with a special appearance by Bubbles. Admission is free and the evening is open to everyone.
tip: Come in the first hour for shorter Santa photo lines and take the reindeer food home to sprinkle outside.
